App.vue.purpose: Shell, theme initialization, global account utilities, responsive sidebar/drawer and RouterView.

components/AppUpdates.vue.purpose: Service-worker update status and explicit check; postpones activation until existing tabs close.

components/AthleteSearch.vue.purpose: Shared bilingual athlete-name search input with a model binding.

components/CommandStatus.vue.purpose: Exact-command persistence, uncertain outcome, retry and rejection feedback.

components/EmptyState.vue.purpose: Shared icon-led empty/no-match state with optional action slot.

components/ExerciseDemo.vue.purpose: Movement demonstration using authorized media or the maintained reference illustration/video.

components/ExercisePicker.vue.purpose: Searchable exercise library popup with equipment/body-area filters and stable selection.

components/ExerciseVideo.vue.purpose: Accessible motion playback with pause, loading/error recovery and reduced-motion handling.

components/FileDropzone.vue.purpose: Shared file-selection/drop surface; emits chosen files while the caller owns validation and upload.

components/ListPagination.vue.purpose: Record totals, page actions and bounded records-per-page selection.

components/MonthCalendar.vue.purpose: Keyboard-operable month grid and selected-date emission.

components/MultiChoice.vue.purpose: Reusable searchable multi-select with selected items and clearing.

components/OverflowMenu.vue.purpose: Labelled menu for secondary or destructive record actions and the coach New menu; items navigate or emit a key while the caller owns the action.

components/PageHeading.vue.purpose: Semantic page-heading layout and action slots.

components/PageState.vue.purpose: Loading/error/retry wrapper that retains responsibility for data in its parent.

components/PasswordField.vue.purpose: Password input with an accessible show/hide action.

components/ResourceAsset.vue.purpose: Authorized private-media preview/download with object-URL lifecycle cleanup.

components/ResourceUpload.vue.purpose: Institution-file upload, including batch composer mode and exact uncertain-upload retry.

components/ScheduleViewSwitch.vue.purpose: Calendar/list route switch preserving query state with a short transition.

components/SectionHeader.vue.purpose: Shared section heading, description and action grouping.

components/SidePanel.vue.purpose: Contextual side panel dialog for in-place tasks (scheduling, record history) with locked dismissal during writes and explicit focus return.

features/account/AccessPage.vue.purpose: Membership/connection recovery with explicit refresh and sign-out.
features/account/AccessPage.vue.access: Signed-in accounts; no institution membership is required to show recovery.
features/account/AccessPage.vue.entry: Router membership/network failure guard; retry or sign out.

features/account/EntryPage.vue.purpose: Dispatch root to first-run setup, sign-in or the current institution dashboard.
features/account/EntryPage.vue.access: Public entry; setup status is read without creating an account.
features/account/EntryPage.vue.entry: Root URL, brand link and missing-page recovery.

features/account/HelpPage.vue.purpose: Institution workflow help, scope/privacy explanation and reference-media credits.
features/account/HelpPage.vue.access: Public help; shell utilities vary with session state.

features/account/LocalPreview.vue.purpose: Synthetic administrator/coach/athlete/operator entry for explicitly enabled local development.
features/account/LocalPreview.vue.access: Development build only, plus local-preview API configuration; never production acquisition.
features/account/LocalPreview.vue.entry: DEV-only shell utility; requires explicit local-preview backend flag.

features/account/LoginPage.vue.purpose: Password sign-in with safe next-path handling and current-context redirect.
features/account/LoginPage.vue.access: Public; successful identity still needs current institution or operator authority.

features/account/PasswordSetupPage.vue.purpose: Choose a password through an administrator-issued expiring single-use reset/setup token.
features/account/PasswordSetupPage.vue.access: Public token entry; backend validates the token, expiry and password rules.
features/account/PasswordSetupPage.vue.entry: Administrator-issued password setup/reset URL shared out of band; not a sidebar item.

features/account/SettingsPage.vue.purpose: Own profile/preferences, session diagnostics, updates, export, sign-out and account-deletion recovery.
features/account/SettingsPage.vue.access: Signed-in account; own data only. Institution-wide settings use a separate route.

features/account/SetupPage.vue.purpose: First-run institution and initial super-admin creation.
features/account/SetupPage.vue.access: Public only while the instance is uninitialized; backend atomically closes setup after success.
features/account/SetupPage.vue.entry: Root setup-status dispatch only before initialization.

features/analytics/AnalyticsPage.vue.purpose: Institution/coaching analytics with activity, delivery and experience tabs and scoped filters.
features/analytics/AnalyticsPage.vue.access: Administrator institution totals; coaches current authorized responsibility. Athlete reads are refused by the API.

features/analytics/ExperienceReport.vue.purpose: Separately labelled athlete session experience and coach workplace satisfaction summaries.

features/analytics/MetricChart.vue.purpose: Responsive metrics chart with tooltip, table equivalent and optional server-authorized record links.

features/analytics/TrainerDelivery.vue.purpose: Coach workload/delivery comparisons with labelled activity measures.

features/coaching/DeliverPlan.vue.purpose: Published-program assignment, athlete selection, concurrent-plan conflict review and replacement choices.
features/coaching/DeliverPlan.vue.access: Administrators and authorized coaches; recipients and program/version access are checked server-side.

features/coaching/ExercisesPage.vue.purpose: Exercise library discovery plus dedicated new/edit route modes, taxonomy and private-media authoring.
features/coaching/ExercisesPage.vue.access: Administrator/coach catalog authority; editability depends on institution/private ownership. Athletes cannot author the catalog.

features/coaching/PlanEditor.vue.purpose: Program draft editor and immutable-version preview, prescription structure, cover, publication and assignment links.
features/coaching/PlanEditor.vue.access: Administrators/coaches edit within program ownership rules; athletes read only their own assigned immutable versions, not staff drafts or unassigned versions.

features/coaching/PlansPage.vue.purpose: Paginated/searchable program library and entry to create, preview or edit.
features/coaching/PlansPage.vue.access: Current institutional members; athletes receive only their own assigned immutable versions, staff authoring remains gated.

features/coaching/PrescriptionFields.vue.purpose: Measurement-aware sets, reps, load, duration, distance, effort and per-set prescription controls.

features/coaching/ProgramCover.vue.purpose: Published program-cover image with unavailable-image fallback, lazy loading and reset when the ID changes.

features/coaching/ReviewPage.vue.purpose: Recorded-workout review, actual results, correction/version information and coach feedback.
features/coaching/ReviewPage.vue.access: Administrators and authorized coaches for the referenced institutional workout; API decides subject scope.

features/institution/AssessmentHistory.v.purpose: Athlete assessment result history with comparable drill charts and versioned results.
features/institution/AssessmentHistory.v.access: Athlete own results; staff only within current subject/event authority.

features/institution/AthletePlans.vue.purpose: Paginated staff assignment directory with dedicated detail routes; no embedded editor/detail below filters.
features/institution/AthletePlans.vue.access: Administrators and training-authorized coaches; supporting links follow the training-scope contract.

features/institution/AthleteProfile.vue.purpose: Person profile with real overview/plans/workouts/assessments/nutrition/participation/manage tabs according to subject role.
features/institution/AthleteProfile.vue.access: Administrators can inspect/manage institutional people. Coaches can inspect their authorized athletes, not a staff directory; sensitive sections retain separate API restrictions.

features/institution/AthleteTraining.vue.purpose: Athlete next-workout agenda and access to unsynced device records; no arbitrary plan-day chooser.
features/institution/AthleteTraining.vue.access: Athlete self through TrainingRoute; authorization for any subject remains server-owned.

features/institution/BrandingSettings.vu.purpose: Instance name, accent, theme backgrounds and logo editing with authorized capability check.
features/institution/BrandingSettings.vu.access: Initial super admin only, inside administrator institution settings.

features/institution/ChannelEditor.vue.purpose: Conversation participant/group editing with authorized roster selection.
features/institution/ChannelEditor.vue.access: Current channel authority; private-pair and group membership rules are enforced by communication API.

features/institution/ChannelsPage.vue.purpose: Conversation directory, unified people/thread search and selection without a separate start page.
features/institution/ChannelsPage.vue.access: Institution members see their own channels; staff can initiate authorized conversations and athletes can initiate pairs with active assigned coaches. Administrators do not gain unrelated private-pair access.

features/institution/ChannelThread.vue.purpose: Message timeline, pagination, per-thread draft, attachment staging, send and participant controls.
features/institution/ChannelThread.vue.access: Authorized participants only; byte and mutation permissions are rechecked server-side.

features/institution/CoachingTeam.vue.purpose: Coach-first supporting selection with immediate acknowledged writes, optional filters, explicit access scope when ambiguous and revision-safe link removal.

features/institution/DashboardPage.vue.purpose: Role dashboard and route-selected People, Activity and Institution settings sections, invitations and close-institution confirmation.
features/institution/DashboardPage.vue.access: Dashboard: all members. People: administrators and coaches with scoped roster. Activity/settings: administrator router gate; branding has a stricter initial-admin check.

features/institution/DelegatedWorkout.vu.purpose: Coach recording of an assigned athlete workout with actual measurement-aware results.
features/institution/DelegatedWorkout.vu.access: Administrators or training-authorized coaches; selected assignment/session permission is checked by API.

features/institution/EventComposer.vue.purpose: Multi-step training/assessment scheduling with group/athlete/staff selection, timezone and template handoff.
features/institution/EventComposer.vue.access: Staff with schedule authority; server validates people, template and event scope.

features/institution/EventDetail.vue.purpose: Scheduled event detail, roster attendance, assessment scores, completion, correction history and makeup links.
features/institution/EventDetail.vue.access: Administrators, designated coach staff and participating athletes receive different authorized projections/actions.

features/institution/FeedbackPage.vue.purpose: Athlete session ratings or coach workplace feedback with prior submissions.
features/institution/FeedbackPage.vue.access: Athlete self or coach self; administrators use analytics instead of submitting personal feedback here.

features/institution/FollowUpPanel.vue.purpose: Derived dashboard follow-ups for missed events, unreviewed workouts, overdue outcomes and unplanned athletes; no Task records.

features/institution/InjuryStatus.vue.purpose: Consent-gated participation status, reporting/correction/closure, policy configuration and athlete export.
features/institution/InjuryStatus.vue.access: Athletes manage their own sensitive record; designated primary coaches receive limited status; administrators configure policy, not unrestricted injury details.

features/institution/InvitationPage.vue.purpose: Accept a seven-day institution invitation and create/sign into the invited account.
features/institution/InvitationPage.vue.access: Public single-use token entry; backend checks expiry, recipient identity and role before membership creation.
features/institution/InvitationPage.vue.entry: Administrator-generated invitation URL shared out of band; not a sidebar item.

features/institution/MemberManagement.vu.purpose: Profile management of identity/access, active state, coach links, sports and password reset issuance.
features/institution/MemberManagement.vu.access: Administrators only through the profile Manage tab; each write is authorized and revision checked.

features/institution/MemberPicker.vue.purpose: Server-searchable authorized roster picker preserving selected identities across result pages.

features/institution/MemberSports.vue.purpose: Selectable sport/specialty buttons for role-relevant institutional metadata.

features/institution/PersonActionIcon.vu.purpose: Decorative SVG profile/message/manage action glyphs; the owning button/link supplies the accessible label.

features/institution/RatingForm.vue.purpose: Reusable scored feedback form with draft recovery, save and discard.

features/institution/ScheduleCalendar.vu.purpose: Timezone-aware calendar plus selected-day booked cards, pagination, month/week/day controls and list switch.
features/institution/ScheduleCalendar.vu.access: Members receive authorized events; staff create and view assigned/institution events, athletes only their participation.

features/institution/ScheduledEvents.vue.purpose: Paginated/searchable Schedule list for training events and assessments, paired with calendar mode.
features/institution/ScheduledEvents.vue.access: Administrators institution-wide; coaches designated events; no unrestricted athlete event index.

features/institution/ServiceCatalog.vue.purpose: Shared group and assessment-template library with distinct list/create/edit route modes.
features/institution/ServiceCatalog.vue.access: Staff; server differentiates group and template commands and validates staff/participant scope.

features/institution/SessionHistory.vue.purpose: Searchable paginated recorded solo-workout history; separate from scheduled group events.
features/institution/SessionHistory.vue.access: Administrators institution-wide, coaches training-authorized subjects, athletes own results where delivery permits.

features/institution/SessionNote.vue.purpose: Institution session/event note editor with acknowledged revision and uncertain-command recovery.

features/institution/SportsSettings.vue.purpose: Institution sport and coaching-specialty taxonomy creation, editing and archival.
features/institution/SportsSettings.vue.access: Administrator settings only; linked historical metadata is retained by server lifecycle rules.

features/institution/TrainingRoute.vue.purpose: Role dispatcher to athlete training or staff athlete-plan index.
features/institution/TrainingRoute.vue.access: Institution members; athlete self screen versus authorized staff browse screen.

features/institution/UpcomingSessions.vu.purpose: Current role's bounded upcoming-event dashboard summary and detail links.

features/navigation/DashboardNav.vue.purpose: Single role-aware sidebar/phone drawer navigation, grouped collapse and active-section highlighting.

features/notifications/NotificationPrefe.purpose: Own in-app/email preference and quiet-hour controls; configuration is distinct from delivery.

features/notifications/NotificationsPage.purpose: Authorized notification inbox, mark/read navigation and embedded preference editing.
features/notifications/NotificationsPage.access: Signed-in recipient only; API resolves and reauthorizes every destination.

features/nutrition/FoodPicker.vue.purpose: Source-backed food search and selection with nutrition/provenance details.

features/nutrition/MacroPlanner.vue.purpose: Nutrition target planning from source kcal and macros without treating unknown values as zero.

features/nutrition/MealFields.vue.purpose: Consumed-food amount/unit/nutrient controls; keeps source and manual quantities distinct.

features/nutrition/MealPlanEditor.vue.purpose: Published-guidance example-day authoring with food search, manual items and nutrient controls.

features/nutrition/NutrientFields.vue.purpose: Shared numeric energy/macro input group preserving source precision and unknown values.

features/nutrition/NutritionPage.vue.purpose: Athlete nutrition detail, staff guidance authoring/publication, example meals, diary sharing, actual intake and version/history recovery.
features/nutrition/NutritionPage.vue.access: Athlete own diary; administrator/primary coach guidance within scoped API rules. Supporting coaches do not acquire nutrition access merely through training links.

features/nutrition/NutritionPlans.vue.purpose: Browse-first paginated nutrition-guidance index and selected-athlete create/open actions.
features/nutrition/NutritionPlans.vue.access: Administrators and authorized primary coaches; summaries do not grant diary visibility.

features/nutrition/NutritionRoute.vue.purpose: Dispatch staff nutrition index versus own/selected-athlete detail using member/plan query state.
features/nutrition/NutritionRoute.vue.access: Current institution member; underlying detail and list endpoints separately enforce subject/diary permissions.

features/platform/PlatformPage.vue.purpose: Local operator support queue, retention/operation retry, diagnostics and authorized audit reads.
features/platform/PlatformPage.vue.access: Separate platform-administrator grant; institutional administrator role alone is insufficient.

features/public/NotFound.vue.purpose: Ordinary missing-route state with root recovery action.
features/public/NotFound.vue.access: Public fallback; not a retired-feature landing page.
features/public/NotFound.vue.entry: Router fallback for unsupported and deleted URLs.

features/public/PrivacyPage.vue.purpose: Instance-local privacy statement and link to Help.
features/public/PrivacyPage.vue.access: Public; deployment-specific legal acceptance remains the institution's responsibility.

features/resources/ResourcesPage.vue.purpose: One searchable institution upload/resource library with preview, archive and restore.
features/resources/ResourcesPage.vue.access: Authorized staff; ownership/scope controls mutation and every private-byte read is checked.

features/support/SupportPage.vue.purpose: Local support request creation, own case history and resolve/reopen; no automatic external email.
features/support/SupportPage.vue.access: Signed-in reporter sees own requests; separate authorized platform operators handle responses.

features/training/WorkoutPage.vue.purpose: Athlete's institutional workout recorder with measured actuals, local persistence, exact sync, conflict recovery and completion summary.
features/training/WorkoutPage.vue.access: Signed-in institutional athlete owning the workout; server and local owner/workspace checks remain authoritative.

features/institution/WorkoutAgenda.vue.purpose: Shared read-only next-workout projection, fixed-time scheduling/reschedule/skip and occurrence-bound start/resume with durable command recovery.

features/institution/AssignedPlanPage.vu.purpose: Dedicated assigned-plan review, scoped workout scheduling and adaptation from the assigned immutable snapshot using the shared editor.
features/institution/AssignedPlanPage.vu.access: Administrators and authorized primary/sport-supporting coaches; athletes redirected before rendering.

features/institution/CoachDesk.vue.purpose: Balanced coach dashboard: disjoint recording/due/planning queues, today events, limited primary-roster participation status and compact follow-up.
features/institution/CoachDesk.vue.access: Coach dashboard only; all reads retain existing server primary/sport authority and limited injury-status visibility.

features/institution/ActivityLog.vue.purpose: Administrator activity log: institution audit events in plain words, grouped by day, with acting and affected member names. Administrators only.

features/institution/AdminOverview.vue.purpose: Administrator overview: existing institution activity/attendance reporting, current roster coverage and operational navigation. No clinical data.

features/institution/AthleteDay.vue.purpose: Athlete daily dashboard: own workout agenda, upcoming events, food-diary entry and assigned coach messaging.

features/institution/WorkoutRuleSettings.purpose: Staff plan scheduling policy: bounded weekly appointments or opt-in day-only preparation, diagnostics, exact-command recovery and future-rule stop/edit.
